name: groff
description: GNU troff document formatting system (groff), implementing troff, pic, eqn, tbl, and the man/mdoc/ms/mom macro packages. Required by man-db to render manual pages.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
